summary: Iteration 5 (overlay opacity reduction + glass panels) - Full frontend regression + readability/visibility sweep of all 8 public routes. ALL criteria PASS. Zero JS console errors across all routes. Background photos are now clearly discernible (previous 75-92% overlays reduced to 30-65%). Text remains fully readable because content that sits directly over photos is now inside translucent glass panels: dark [#0C2415]/75 for white text, white/85 for dark headings, [#5E2209]/70 for the donate banner. Contact form POST /api/contact -> 200 with success toast. Donation flow POST /api/donations/checkout -> 200 and produces a valid Stripe checkout URL (checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...) which was intercepted (not paid).

READABILITY_VISIBILITY_ALL_8_ROUTES.details: Screenshotted hero + key sections of /, /services, /residences, /a-propos, /regions, /carrieres, /contact, /don at 1920x1080. On every hero, the underlying photo (nurse, plants/lobby, seniors, caregiver, etc.) is clearly visible while the H1 white heading remains fully readable over the left dark green (from-[#0C2415]/85 via /45 to /5) or dark orange (donation, from-[#7A2E0E]/85 via /55 to /10) gradient. Body sections (mission, devise, features, banner) that overlay text on photos are inside translucent glass panels.

HOME_GLASS_PANELS.details: Verified via computed DOM: (1) Dark glass devise panel bg-[#0C2415]/75 + backdrop-blur present with text 'NOTRE DEVISE / « Accueillir avec amour... »' over the visible caregiving photo. (2) White glass mission panel bg-white/85 + backdrop-blur-md present with 'Une vision humaine et durable...' over the softLight golden texture. (3) Dark orange glass donate banner bg-[#5E2209]/70 present with 'Votre generosité transforme des vies...' over the visible photo. Hero gradient from-[#0C2415]/80 via /40 to transparent confirmed on nurse photo.

ABOUT_ENGAGEMENTS_CHIP.details: About page /a-propos: 'Nos engagements' h2 wrapped in inline white glass chip bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-2xl over homeCare photo. Chip visible in screenshot; heading dark on white for excellent contrast.

RESIDENCES_FEATURES_CHIP.details: Residences page /residences: h2 'Nos espaces et commodités' wrapped in white glass chip bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-sm over lobby photo. Chip visible; heading readable.

Frontend then attempted navigation to 'https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a1Hu802fUHZnchn7I7kpsZu5HvMfWHgJ5ax1dEc8uiPNXHNiSkHBfVJCcs' which was blocked by page.route() (no real payment).

critical_code_review_comments: Overlay opacity reduction is applied consistently across all 8 pages using the same gradient tokens (from-[#0C2415]/85 via /45 to /5 for green pages, from-[#7A2E0E]/85 via /55 to /10 for donation). Consider extracting these into a small Tailwind component/class for future maintainability.

Glass-panel wrappers (bg-[#0C2415]/75 backdrop-blur-sm, bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md) are duplicated between Home / About / Residences. A shared <GlassPanel tone='dark|light'> component would reduce duplication if more pages adopt this pattern.
Home.jsx is now ~200 lines and still under the 700-line threshold; no split needed at this iteration.
